messages:
Noah: Hi folks, first-day snag. Fresh M2 Air. Kandji install UI fails with '407 Proxy Authentication Required' when trying to download the enrollment profile. I'm on the office guest network which uses a company proxy/SSL intercept. FileVault escrow never showed up. Any tips? @IT Oncall
IT Oncall: hey Noah 44b 407 usually means the system can't talk through the corporate proxy to Apple's/DEP APIs. Two quick checks: are you on a VPN/proxy set in System Settings > Network? and can you try a direct tether (phone) or wired ethernet? Also DM the serial.
Noah: Serial C02R4N6T7Y8Q. I don't have a wired jack near me but can hotspot. System proxy shows a manual HTTP proxy set by the office profile.
Sofia: welcome! our proxy does MITM TLS for inspection which can break MDM enrollment unless the proxy's cert is preinstalled in System Keychain before Setup Assistant finishes. Hotspot is usually fastest to bypass.
IT Oncall: agree. If you can hotspot for 10 minutes, try enroll again. If not, we can open a short Okta elevation so we can install the proxy CA into the System keychain and re-run enrollment. Which do you prefer?
Noah: I can hotspot. Trying that first.
Alex: FYI I checked ABM and your serial looks good/assigned. No DEP issues. This is definitely a network/proxy issue. I'll stand by to push the Kandji blueprint once enroll completes.
Kandji Bot: Device C02R4N6T7Y8Q has no enrollment profile applied. Pending user action.
Noah: Switched to phone hotspot, retried enroll UI  now it progresses but stalls at 'Waiting for FileVault escrow' and the escrow dialog doesn't detect my YubiKey when inserted. Device shows 'Enrolled' in Kandji though.
IT Oncall: good progress. For the YubiKey: try running `ykman list` in Terminal while the escrow dialog is open. Some USB-C hubs cause detection issues; if you're using a hub try plugging directly. Also confirm the YubiKey is configured for FIDO/U2F and not only NFC-only mode.
Noah: Plugged YubiKey directly, ran `ykman list` and it shows the token. Escrow dialog finally detected it and pushed recovery key. Rosetta still needed; will that be auto?
Sofia: Rosetta isn't auto for Apple Silicon if you didn't launch an x86 app. Run: `/usr/sbin/softwareupdate --install-rosetta --agree-to-license` to install now. GlobalProtect will be pushed by Kandji after policy applies.
IT Oncall: since enroll succeeded I pushed the 'dev-onboard' blueprint. You may get a Kandji prompt to permit system extensions; accept in System Settings > Privacy & Security. Also if you need local installs we can open a 60min Okta elevation.
Noah: Saw the system extension prompt, allowed it. Rosetta installed with the suggested command. GlobalProtect installed automatically and I logged in. All green. Thanks!
Devex Bot: Tip posted to onboarding channel: if office proxy is in play, tether first or request Okta temp-admin to install proxy CA into System keychain before enrollment.
Noah: Leaving a quick note: if you hit 407 during Kandji enroll -> try phone hotspot or request short Okta elevation to add proxy CA. YubiKey escrow may need direct USB connection and `ykman` to confirm detection. Super helpful, thanks everyone :tada:
